summary: Live backend regression and mobile web screening flow tested. Backend passed 4/4 tests; landing through NPDR results and export passed. Scan-another navigation showed duplicate upload-screen nodes and did not resolve cleanly.

integration_issues.issue: After tapping scan-another, two upload-screen nodes remained in the DOM and the expected upload screen did not resolve unambiguously within 8 seconds.

action_items: Investigate Expo Router replace/back-stack behavior after Scan another image; ensure only one upload screen is mounted and navigation settles.
Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract or explicitly document EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as the supported key.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py supplies localhost fallback values for MONGO_URL and DB_NAME, contrary to the fail-fast environment configuration requirement.
retinaApi.ts includes a local sample fallback, which is a MOCKED/FALLBACK data path if the live samples API fails; live tests used the real API successfully.
Expo startup logs report a React Native DevTools Electron sandbox warning, but Metro bundled and the web app rendered.
seed_data_creation: Created live screening records via sample prediction requests; no seed data was added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the public preview URL from frontend/.env. Core normal and NPDR sample flows pass; focus retesting results-to-upload navigation and verify export semantics beyond tap response.
rca_of_issue: The scan-another action calls clearSelection() and router.replace('/upload'). The preview then exposed two upload-screen testID nodes, suggesting an Expo Router retained/stale route tree or replace transition issue; reproduce with DOM count and URL inspection before changing navigation structure.
